commands.name: schema.describe
commands.description: Describe the mounted tables, columns, semantic types, sensitivity tiers, measures, link types, and provenance in the open NakliData workbook.

commands.name: tables.list
commands.description: List the mounted tables in the open NakliData workbook with row counts and source identifiers.

commands.name: cells.list
commands.description: List the notebook cells and their editable source code in the open NakliData workbook without exposing raw result rows.

commands.name: lineage.read
commands.description: Read the source-to-cell-to-sink lineage graph of the open NakliData workbook.

commands.name: query.run
commands.description: Run a bounded, read-only SQL value query over public columns in the open NakliData workbook (requires the tab's values:read grant and redacts non-public columns).

sql.description: Read-only SELECT projection over mounted tables, e.g. "SELECT vendor_name, total_amount FROM invoices LIMIT 25"

commands.name: fs.list
commands.description: List supported data files and .naklidata workbooks in NakliData's hosted NakliOS storage namespace.

commands.name: fs.open
commands.description: Mount a supported data file or open a .naklidata workbook from NakliData's hosted NakliOS storage namespace.

path.description: App-relative file path inside apps/naklidata/, e.g. "sales.csv" or "q3.naklidata"

commands.name: sql.propose
commands.description: Stage an editable, un-run SQL cell in NakliData's notebook and Review tray for the person to inspect and run.

sql.description: SQL statement to stage as an un-run cell

name.description: Optional display title for the proposed SQL cell

commands.name: chart.propose
commands.description: Stage an editable chart cell over an existing result cell in NakliData's notebook and Review tray.

inputCellId.description: Identifier of the upstream SQL cell

yColumn.description: Y or numeric measure column name

commands.name: quality.propose
commands.description: Stage a portable data-quality assertion cell in NakliData's notebook and Review tray without executing it.

commands.name: cleaning.propose
commands.description: Stage a suggested table-cleaning step as an editable, un-run SQL cell in NakliData's notebook and Review tray.
